blocks.h2: Water Heater Installation Questions From Mokena Homeowners

items.q: How long does water heater replacement take?
items.answer: Most standard tank replacements take a few hours. Switching fuel type or moving the heater takes longer.

items.q: What size water heater do I need?
items.answer: For most Mokena homes, a 40 or 50-gallon tank works. Larger families or big soaking tubs may need more. We'll size it to your household.

items.q: Do I need an expansion tank?
items.answer: Often. If your home has a pressure-reducing valve or a backflow device, an expansion tank protects the heater and plumbing from pressure spikes.

items.q: Do you take the old water heater?
items.answer: Yes. We drain it, disconnect it and haul it away.

items.q: How much does water heater replacement cost in Mokena?
items.preview: It depends on size, type and venting. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the size, fuel type, venting and any code updates. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
